project_type: React 19 + Vite 7 + Supabase government disaster response platform
build_system: Vite with manual code splitting, PWA plugin, Terser minification, CSS minification enabled
test_framework: None detected - no test suite currently configured
test_command: npm run lint (ESLint only, no unit tests)
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no errors. Check dist/ bundle sizes. Manually test dark mode toggle, search features, pagination controls, cookie consent banner, and all interactive elements in browser on localhost:5173 using 'npm run dev'. Verify accessibility with keyboard navigation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder (entire production build output), manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, workbox service worker. These are git-ignored and regenerated on every build.
environment_constraints: React 19 in StrictMode; Mapbox GL requires special Vite config for buffer polyfills; service worker caches cleared on page load (see index.html script); @tanstack/react-query already configured in main.jsx with 5min staleTime; dark mode uses ThemeContext + CSS custom properties; no server restart needed (pure client app); admin routes use lazy loading
contribution_requirements: Autonomous execution per AGENTS.md - run builds, installs, and checks without asking. Professional government design aesthetic - no playful elements. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance mandatory. Remove placeholder text, em-dashes, purple gradients, pill buttons. Replace with Palayan City brand (blue/green/neutral, government seal). All copy must be real government messaging.
key_patterns: Inline styles (not Tailwind classes except for utility functions), framer-motion for animations, lucide-react for icons, CSS custom properties for theming (--text-primary, --bg-card, --btn-primary-bg, etc.), lazy loading via React.lazy + Suspense (MapScreen, AdminDashboard, LegalScreen already use this), image lazy loading with loading='lazy' attribute (already used in ReportCard, AdminDashboard, PhotoCard), React.memo on ReportCard, useMemo/useCallback in HomeScreen and MapScreen for expensive computations, @tanstack/react-query already wrapping all Supabase queries with QueryClientProvider in main.jsx, pagination hooks already exist (usePaginatedReports, usePaginatedAdvisories, etc.) with useInfiniteQuery, debounce hook exists in components/map/SearchBar.jsx (useDebounce), server.js Express backend handles email
directory_structure: src/ contains components/ (layout/, map/, ui/, dashboard/, ui/report/), context/ (ThemeContext), hooks/ (pagination hooks), lib/ (supabase, logger, sanitize, security, utils), screens/ (Home, Map, Admin*, Profile, Emergency, ElNino, Legal), services/ (kloudtechService). public/ holds static assets (images, geojson, tourism data). database/ holds SQL migrations. .agents/tasks/ for workflow artifacts.
